test_title: PYST 10: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 22nd November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Eight friends, P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W, are watching a movie sitting in a line. T is sitting at one of the corners. Q is sitting between W and R. V is sitting between S and U. W is sitting to the immediate right of T. R is sitting to the immediate left of P. There are two persons between P and U. Who is sitting at the other corner?
solution:
Eight friends, P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W, are watching a movie sitting in a line.

1) T is sitting at one of the corners.

Case (i) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dfd465293de3d09e6f61872eaa1307eb9f130609c9f27c615e316942f628aef3.png] 

Case (ii) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da304af426ea3491369ecf184198fb908df3dcca88faa3c63c75524c3fd205ca.png] 

2) W is sitting to the immediate right of T.

3) Q is sitting between W and R.

4) R is sitting to the immediate left of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc38cf710700958c14d8f5a33d5cfaac740d96109535a30af3b3ed83d602ade9.png] 

5) There are two persons between P and U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad0f718332d23d34913cb0bfc85eb48197744738f06c8f855b0a63eefcc0e3d0.png] 

6) V is sitting between S and U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9bfa73dcb58e5051447f8357995d8cda29c6a7632ab960b5b3ec0bf02d9ad929.png] 

∴ Here, 'U' is sitting on other corner in line.

Hence, the correct answer is **"U".**
